references.title: ICH efficacy guidelines (E6 Good Clinical Practice)

title: Clinical Trial Eligibility Screener
short: Turns complex inclusion and exclusion criteria into a checklist and flags patients who may qualify.
symptom: Clinical trials struggle to find eligible patients
ingredient: An eligibility checker for trial teams
directions: Load the protocol criteria. Each candidate is checked criterion by criterion, with every “maybe” sent to the investigator.
problem: Eligibility criteria are long and written in free text, so screening patients is slow and error-prone.
why: Slow recruitment is a leading reason trials run late or fail to finish.
solution: Converts protocol criteria into structured rules, checks de-identified patient data against each one, and lists matches, exclusions and unknowns for the investigator to confirm.
technology: Criteria parsing with a language model
limitations: Needs ethics approval and de-identified data
Final eligibility is always the investigator’s decision
review: The investigator confirms eligibility for every candidate; the tool only pre-screens.
